added.lifecycle_mode: Reference candidates are explicitly non-executable; active tasks require authentic reviewed interpretation.
added.full_evidence_binding: Bridge, packet, checks, review, PR evidence, and acceptance bind current inputs and source.
added.write_ownership: Executor, Brain, human, and later machine outputs are separated.
added.non_self_referential_finalization: Brain, PR, and human receipts bind one reviewed source HEAD; current HEAD may add only mechanically proven evidence files.

removed: Fixture interpretation as an execution-release substitute.
Impossible exact-current-HEAD self-reference for committed approval receipts.

candidate_behavior.from: Candidate could appear executable after temporary CI regeneration.
candidate_behavior.to: Reference candidate is safely HARD_STOP/HALT until a real active task is created.

closure_gate.from: HARD_STOP with execution_allowed=false was not itself a blocker.
closure_gate.to: Reference, HARD_STOP, non-released, and HALT states always block closure.

unchanged: Human transfer and final acceptance remain mandatory.
No autonomous background system is introduced.
user_confirmation_reference: Project conversation on 2026-07-21 approving continued repair after unfamiliar cold review.
